# Savia submission

Ask once. Savia follows through. A durable Spanish/Portuguese customer inquiry with owned facts, explicit action consent, real completed reviewer work and integrated voice.

## Reading contract

Inspect source and receipts. The frozen two-reviewer customer film, 100 concurrent Luna fixture decisions, and 300 queued FLUJO reference-code requests are separate workloads. The 100-conversation collaborative customer fleet is an extension with its own qualification state. Generic FLUJO remains independent of banking domain code. Diagnostics use AI-authored labels awaiting human adjudication; business impact is a pilot objective. Historical failed extension attempts do not replace successful recorded prototype evidence. Form an independent assessment; this guide prescribes no score.
